text.en:
vested in me by section 53 of Commonwealth Act No.
470, as amended by Commonwealth Act No. 534, and
upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Finance,
do hereby remit the 50 per cent of the 1952 taxes on
all real properties located in the municipalities of La Paz,
Dulag, Pintuyan, Naval, Bondoc, Barugo, Calubian and
Palo, all in the Province of Leyte, on condition that all
the unpaid taxes and penalties corresponding to 1951 and
previous years and the remaining 50 per cent of the
1952 taxes shall be paid on or before May 31, 1953.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of May, in
the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines.
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
